client.operating_mode: fresh web conversations; one task per conversation

tools.network_policy: offline after staging; web search and external connectors disabled for all scored sessions

notes: Capture the actual OS, browser and ChatGPT Web client details from the benchmark host; use null when a value is not exposed.
Record the exact model label and reasoning setting shown by the ChatGPT Web interface before the first run; do not infer a hidden model build.
Use the exact installed plugin/Skill source commit and version recorded above. Do not benchmark against a moving branch.
A and B use fresh conversations with identical built-in tools and staged input files. No external search, connected apps, or external APIs are allowed during scored runs.

Arm A must have the Particle Physics Research plugin unselected and no Skill references in its context. Arm B explicitly selects and invokes the installed plugin. If A receives Skill instructions or plugin tool context, invalidate the pair.
The 30-minute wall-time and 25-tool-call limits apply equally to both arms. Token counts are recorded only if exposed.
